Tom Baker

Democratic candidate for 15th Court of Appeals, Place 2, Texas

Attorney in private practice in Killeen; former justice of the Texas Third Court of Appeals

Tom (Thomas J.) Baker is a Democrat and a U.S. Navy veteran. He served as a justice on the Austin-based Texas Third Court of Appeals, Place 5, from 2019 through 2024. He was unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for 15th Court of Appeals, Place 2, and faces Republican Scott K. Field on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

Where Baker stands

Judicial philosophy / partisanship
Says party affiliation and political philosophy should not affect any ruling before a court.
Judicial record
Sat on the Third Court of Appeals when it upheld Harris County's mask mandate in 2020, and when it upheld an injunction blocking a ban on the sale of consumable hemp products in 2023.

Background

  • Justice, Texas Third Court of Appeals, Place 5 (2019–2024); elected in 2018
  • Partner, Baker & Tisdale, PLLC (2015–2018)
  • Attorney in private practice, Killeen
  • U.S. Navy veteran
  • J.D., University of Houston Law Center (1983)
  • Unopposed Democratic nominee, 15th Court of Appeals Place 2 (March 3, 2026 primary)
